forensic_audit.finding_title: Forensic Audit of Previous Ridge R2=0.9999 / MAE=0.33

diagnostics.root_cause_analysis: The cleaned dataset in agrisense_outputs contains artificially generated/interpolated modal prices where day-to-day changes in Tomato and Potato are perfectly collinear (correlation=1.000000). Because prices were generated along an analytical smooth curve, lag_1 alone captures 99.99% of the variance with near-zero residual error. The reported R2=0.9999 is therefore an artifact of synthetic data smoothness, NOT genuine market forecasting capability.
diagnostics.recommendation: Reject the R2=0.9999 metric as unrepresentative of volatile agricultural spot markets. Revalidate forecasting models strictly against authentic AGMARKNET / Karnataka APMC mandi observations.

evaluation_summary.key_finding: On authentic volatile mandi spot observations, price changes exhibit realistic variance. Baseline persistence error increases naturally from Horizon 1 to Horizon 30. Ridge and GBDT models outperform static baselines across multi-day horizons without artificial 0.9999 overfit.
